name: PlasmaWave-TS-TW

frames.best_why: A long cyan ribbon unrolls beside the violet loops, filling the middle with the clearest shapes.

tagline: Cyan and violet light ribbons loop and bend across black.
summary: Glowing three-dimensional ribbons of cyan and magenta twist like neon tubes through a dark space. The shapes curl and travel continuously, lit from within and fading at the edges.
appearance: A cluster of thick glowing loops and bands across the middle of a black frame, mostly bright cyan with magenta-violet tubes threading between them. Surfaces are smooth and rounded with hot white highlights, and the top and bottom stay black.
behaviour: The ribbons roll and slide along their length at a steady pace, knots loosening and tightening. Nothing reacts to the pointer; the motion is a single endless loop.
use_when: A bold dark hero needs a futuristic burst of neon depth behind a short headline.
avoid_when: You need full-frame coverage or calm: the ribbons sit in a horizontal band and never pause.
customise: The two colours, both speeds and bend values, focal length, offset, rotation and second-wave direction are props. The ribbon geometry is fixed.
weight_why: A per-pixel raymarch runs every frame, up to fourteen steps per pixel.

a11y.note: Decorative and always moving, with no reduced-motion check and nothing to operate.

issues: The waves stay in a middle horizontal band, leaving the top and bottom of the frame empty black.
polish_why: Vivid, convincing 3D neon with strong glow; the empty upper and lower thirds weaken it.
